summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package advertises itself as a Cypress selector utility but its preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated bundle using shuffled string-array indirection and hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x...`, `MmgoCP`, `WV8StW`, string-array rotator), with no relationship to Cypress selector functionality. Executing an obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at install time evades Node-based supply-chain scanners and is the canonical alternate-runtime dropper shape. The scope `@servicetitan/*` resembles the ServiceTitan corporate scope but this specific version ships an install-time dropper inconsistent with the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
